sentences.text: Traveling opens your mind to new cultures.
sentences.translation: 旅行能开阔眼界，了解新文化。

sentences.text: More tourists are visiting Asia this year.
sentences.translation: 今年有更多游客到访亚洲。

sentences.text: Learning a few local phrases makes travel easier.
sentences.translation: 学会几句当地用语会让旅行更轻松。

sentences.text: Every city has its own unique story to tell.
sentences.translation: 每座城市都有自己独特的故事。

sentences.text: The best souvenirs are the memories you bring home.
sentences.translation: 最好的纪念品是你带回家的回忆。
